all_outcomes: No outcome exclusions, adaptive stopping, held-out hyperparameter tuning or post-outcome selector changes. Failed/nonfinite jobs recorded and investigated, not silently removed.
calibration_rule: One nonnegative score-to-loss scale per arm, fitted by within-task-centered least squares on development outcomes and capped at256. No further tuning. Predicted loss=L_initial-scale*U+0.08*C.
confirmatory_policy: Seal all candidate scores and all selector/baseline choices before ANY confirmatory training. Verify source/protocol/calibration/selection hashes in every training shard. Independent seeds and held-out angles; calibration/training/test samples disjoint.
inference: Twenty independent task seeds, each containing paired rank/noise/angle conditions. Bootstrap whole-seed averages10000times; report task-level records, subgroup results, within-task ranks, selected topology/budget and negative results. No candidate- or condition-level pseudoreplication.
model: Explicit 15-node passive tree transfer with eight leaf inputs and an imposed context decoder; 64 trainable leaf-input weights; no natural somatic decoder claim.
primary_objective: Actual trained held-out half mean-square error + 0.08*C at step256. Regret versus retrospectively observed best candidate on the same task; all candidate outcomes retained.
reference_spectrum: At W=0 and isotropic x with orthogonal teacher, exact decoder-space credit second moment=(1+noise_sd^2)*Q diag(1/rank active entries) Q^T; Q follows a one-parameter orthogonal rotation. The joint H changes transported/parameter-gradient spectra and this is reported.
resource_definition: C=K/8+0.1*cable_length/max_candidate_cable_length; geometric edge lengths under a declared 2D embedding are a proxy, not measured metabolic or biological wiring cost. All candidates pay 64 trainable weights and the same 64 fixed decoder coefficients. Every route cut has eight nonzero decoder-to-leaf delivery entries, 8*K possible fixed context-to-route encoder coefficients, K transmitted scalar coefficients per trial, 15 electrical nodes and 14 edges; those counts are exported. The cost penalizes channel count and the declared cable proxy, not all conceivable costs.
scope: Feedback-only versus jointly changed linear passive forward transfer and feedback routes. Finite costed candidate selection, not a validated natural dendritic morphology law.
title: Prospective costed selection in tree-constrained linear learning
utility: eta*gradL dot E[d] - eta^2*L*E||d||^2/2. Exact finite-calibration empirical mean and covariance trace of true iid-with-replacement minibatch32 updates. L is the global quadratic calibration Hessian spectral norm.
